title: Prompt fidelity of ChatGPT4o / Dall-E3 text-to-image visualisations

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing text-to-image prompt fidelity by comparing the specific age cohort requested in the autogenously generated text prompt with the visual age of the rendered subject (classified by ChatGPT-4o).

bias_targets.target: Physical appearance and occupational stereotyping bias
bias_targets.methodology: Scoring generative AI image outputs for the correct rendering of prompt-specified physical attributes (hair style, attire, glasses) and occupational paraphernalia (name tags, clipboards) to measure stereotype leakage and deviations from explicit instructions.
